ItemId.description: The document's 26-character id. A draft with this id is replaced; an issued document with this id is kept as it is.

Number.description: The document's number, kept as it is. Required on an issued document; refused when another document of the site holds it.

BillTo.description: Who is billed: Party (Kind and Id), Contact (Name, Email, Phone, Address), TaxId, TaxTreatment, ExemptionReason and CopyTo.

Issuer.description: The business that issued it, as copied at issue.

Lines.description: The lines: Id, Kind (Item, Service, Discount, Text), Name, Description, Quantity, Unit, UnitPrice, DiscountPercent, DiscountAmount, TaxCategoryCode, Taxes, and the computed Net, TaxAmount and Total.

Taxes.description: The tax lines, one per rate.

Totals.description: Subtotal, DiscountTotal, ChargeTotal, TaxTotal, RoundingAmount and Total.

IssuedUtc.description: When it was issued, in UTC (ISO 8601).

CreatedUtc.description: When it was created, in UTC (ISO 8601); kept.

InvoiceId.description: The id of the invoice it credits.

InvoiceNumber.description: The number of the invoice it credits.

Disposition.description: ReduceBalance, Refund or CustomerCredit (or its number).

Status.description: Draft, Issued or Voided (or its number).

CreditNotes.description: The credit notes to import, as a CreditNotes deployment step writes them. Import the invoices first.
